workflow.name: Test Generation Workflow
workflow.description: Analyze an existing codebase and generate comprehensive test suites. Supports unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests.

variables.name: git_url
variables.label: Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository to generate tests for

variables.name: test_focus
variables.label: Testing Focus
variables.description: Specific modules, files, or features to focus testing on
variables.defaultValue: All business logic and API endpoints

variables.name: test_framework
variables.label: Test Framework
variables.description: Testing framework (e.g., Jest, Vitest, Pytest, JUnit)

stages.name: Codebase Analysis
stages.description: Analyze the codebase to understand testable units

prompts.label: Analyze for Testing
prompts.text:
Analyze the codebase at {{run.codebases.target.path}} to identify testable units. Focus on {{test_focus}}.

Identify:
1. Functions/methods to test
2. Classes with business logic
3. API endpoints
4. Data transformations
5. Edge cases and error scenarios
6. Current test coverage gaps

stages.name: Unit Test Generation
stages.description: Generate unit tests for individual functions and methods

prompts.label: Generate Unit Tests
prompts.text:
Generate comprehensive unit tests using {{test_framework}}. For each testable unit identified:
1. Happy path tests
2. Error/edge case tests
3. Boundary value tests
4. Mock external dependencies

Follow {{language}} testing best practices. Use descriptive test names.

stages.name: Integration Test Generation
stages.description: Generate integration tests for module interactions

prompts.label: Generate Integration Tests
prompts.text:
Generate integration tests for the key interaction points between modules. Test:
1. API endpoint flows
2. Database operations
3. Service layer interactions
4. Event/message flows

Use {{test_framework}} with appropriate setup/teardown.

stages.name: Test Report
stages.description: Generate a test coverage report and recommendations

prompts.label: Generate Test Report
prompts.text:
Generate a comprehensive test report including:
1. Test inventory (all tests generated)
2. Coverage analysis
3. Critical paths covered
4. Remaining gaps
5. Recommendations for additional testing
6. Setup instructions for running the tests
